## Part 2 practicals {#part-2-practicals}

Apply the descriptive methods in order. Each practical includes explained R code,
executed results, charts and independent tasks.

| Practical | Read online | Download |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Categorical business data — mutual funds | [Open practical](practicals/practical-01-categorical-business-data.html) | [PDF](pdf/practical-01-categorical-business-data.pdf) |
| 2. Numerical business data — cereals | [Open practical](practicals/practical-02-numerical-business-data.html) | [PDF](pdf/practical-02-numerical-business-data.pdf) |
| 3. Association and group comparisons — mutual funds | [Open practical](practicals/practical-03-association-and-groups.html) | [PDF](pdf/practical-03-association-and-groups.pdf) |

## Work with R or study offline

- [Download the complete student RStudio project](downloads/applied-statistics-rstudio.zip): editable lessons and practicals, teaching CSVs, images, and setup instructions. Extract the ZIP, then open `Applied-Statistics.Rproj` in RStudio.
- [Download all lesson and practical PDFs](downloads/applied-statistics-pdfs.zip).

The online lessons and PDFs show the code and its results. To run or change R code, use the RStudio project.
